name: Resend developer email platform landing page by resend.com
description: A near-black developer landing page built on a repeating chapter rhythm: each product claim is introduced by a glossy 3D icon and a centred serif heading with an italic orange accent phrase, then immediately proven with a real artifact — a tabbed code window, a code/live-preview split, or an actual product screenshot. Hierarchy comes from a high-contrast serif display face (roman and italic mixed at ~90px) over a small muted grotesque body, with density swinging between airy section intros and dense utilitarian blocks: a 13-icon SDK row, a 3×3 deliverability grid, and bordered cards containing mock-UI states. Colour discipline holds the page together — #0a0a0a canvas, white headlines, #a1a1aa body, orange #ff5a1f reserved for accent italics, green and red confined to semantic statuses — flowing through a monochrome logo wall, a single anchor testimonial, a three-card quote grid, and a five-column footer.
